title: THE CONTROLS LEGEND STEPS ASIDE FOR THE BACKPACK
why: Seen on the 4K raid screenshot of 2026-10-07: with the backpack open the controls legend ran under its left edge and its second column showed through the panel. The backpack has its own key line, so the legend now steps aside while the backpack is open and comes back when it closes.
now: Opening the backpack hides the controls legend until you close it.
